description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained NextItNet model through the host ModelView interface and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and explicit definitions.
motivation: Guide model improvements using reproducible evidence while preserving NextItNet compatibility, fixed benchmark conditions, and the single-model-per-category requirement.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Consume batches shaped B × L containing sequence, positive, and negative tensors. Access the actual network through view.model and preserve item_emb, log2feats, and predict_score compatibility. Mask padding and invalid targets; use the final nonpadding position for left-padded histories, never count−1. Use only available histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Mark unavailable review information and simulator traits as unobserved. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for five training users per category. Select models using macro validation HR@10 across all four categories; diagnostic proxies must not replace that metric. Keep inference and the embedded predictor writer consistent with each category’s single trained checkpoint.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
                features = view.log2feats(sequence)
                identify valid positions and targets
                measure defined diagnostics using features and view.predict_score
            aggregate measurements with explicit denominators
        restore model training state
        return {metrics, metric_definitions}

def diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    distinguish observations from hypotheses
    state unavailable information explicitly
    request NextItNet-compatible, single-model improvement hypotheses

originality.positive: Combines a stable diagnostic interface with family-specific probes and evidence-grounded interpretation.
originality.negative: The description specifies an integration contract rather than a new diagnostic algorithm or demonstrated scientific contribution.

future_potential.positive: Could support repeatable diagnosis and targeted architecture or optimization experiments across sequential recommendation models.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on choosing reliable diagnostic measurements and validating proposed improvements; no effectiveness results are supplied.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch structure make the adapter straightforward to organize.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding masks, score shapes, aggregation, model-state restoration, and predictor consistency require careful implementation.
